notes.title: Major Update for DreamDasher v2.1
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone that has provided feedback on DreamDasher over the years!  

We just released a major update v2.1 that revamps dashing, jumping, knock-back, battles, along with additional bug fixes. These are all improvements based on player feedback.  Thank you for sending them in!

These changes are available in the v2.1 release (you can see the version in the lower left on the main menu). Thank you again for all of your input, and please post any additional feedback to the discussion board, in a review, or send email to support@c3bgames.com.  Thank you!
